title: Sindh Local Government Second Amendment Act 2010

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Local Government Second Amendment Act 2010
sections.description:
Short title, extent and commencement

ACT VI OF 2010
ACT VI OF 2010
SINDH LOCAL GOVERNMENT (SECOND AMENDMENT) ACT, 2010
An Act further to amend the Sindh Local
Government Ordinance, 2001
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part-IV,
14th April, 2010]
No.PAS/Legis-B-3/2010,
dated 14-4-2010.---The Sindh local Government (Second
Amendment) Bill, 2010 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 26th March, 2010 and assented to by the Governor
of Sindh on 9th April, 2010 is hereby published as an
Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
Preamble.---Whereas it is
expedient further to amend the Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 2001, in the manner
hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby
enacted as follows:--
1. Short title,
extent and commencement.---(1) This Act may be called the Sindh
Local Government (Second Amendment) Act, 2010.
(2) It shall come
into force at once.

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Local Government Second Amendment Act 2010
sections.description:
Amendment in section 179-A of Sindh Ordinance No.XXVII of 2001

ACT VI OF 2010
ACT VI OF 2010
SINDH LOCAL GOVERNMENT (SECOND AMENDMENT) ACT, 2010
An Act further to amend the Sindh Local
Government Ordinance, 2001
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part-IV,
14th April, 2010]
No.PAS/Legis-B-3/2010,
dated 14-4-2010.---The Sindh local Government (Second Amendment) Bill, 2010
having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 26th March, 2010 and
assented to by the Governor of Sindh on 9th April, 2010 is hereby published as
an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
Preamble.---Whereas it is expedient further to amend the Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 2001, in
the manner hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby
enacted as follows:--
2. Amendment in
section 179-A of Sindh Ordinance No.XXVII of 2001.---In the Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 2001 in
section 179-A, for subsection (3), the following shall be substituted:--
"(3) The Government shall appoint Administrators
from amongst the Civil Servants including employees of Local Government
Department, Government of Sindh and Officers of Sindh Councils Unified Grades,
who shall perform the functions and exercise the powers of the Nazims of
respective Local Governments, till the newly elected Nazims take oath of their
offices:
Provided that the
Administrators shall be appointed from amongst the officers in basic scale 19
and above in the case of District Governments and in basic scale 17, 18 and
above in the case of Taluka and Town Administrations:
Provided further
that Government may, in the public interest, transfer any Administrator or
proceed against him on account of misconduct and appoint another officer in his
place.
